Singer_refinement.object: (oriented triple A, Sylow-5 subgroup P on A^c)

boundary: Exact for the A8 permutation actions. This constructs the oriented cover and common 672-object refinement; it does not identify the 280-dimensional Singer complement with an exceptional Lie-algebra module.

exceptional_boundary.E7_56: The E7 minuscule 56 restricts to Lambda^2(8) + Lambda^2(8)^*, so it is not this Johnson action.
exceptional_boundary.Lambda3_8: The oriented double cover is the signed basis orbit of the 56-dimensional SL8 module Lambda^3(8).
exceptional_boundary.conclusion: The Singer decoration supplies a sixfold pentagon refinement of the oriented exterior-basis cover, not an identification with the E7 weight set.

oriented_Johnson.signed_exterior_identification: The 112 objects are exactly the signed basis vectors ±(e_i wedge e_j wedge e_k) of Lambda^3(F^8).
oriented_Johnson.stabilizer_identification: A3 x A5 = C3 x A5

six_pentagon_action.oriented_image: A5 on its six Sylow-5 subgroups
